properties.address: St Winifred Road, Rainhill, Liverpool L35
properties.summary:
This semi-detached house on St Winifred Road in Rainhill offers three bedrooms, a through lounge and dining room, a kitchen, a conservatory and a ground floor shower room. Outside there are front and rear gardens, a driveway and an attached garage. The property has gas central heating and partial double glazing.

The home is in a popular area with local schools and amenities nearby, and is offered with no onward chain. It has been back on the market after a period off the market, and the asking price has been reduced several times.

properties.address: New Street, Sutton, St Helens, WA9
properties.summary:
This two-bedroom freehold terraced house on New Street in Sutton, St Helens, is offered for sale with no onward chain. It features a garden-fronted entrance, a lounge, a kitchen diner, a ground-floor bathroom, two double bedrooms and a larger-than-average rear garden. The property is unmodernised and would suit buyers willing to update it.

Located close to Lea Green railway station, Sherdley Park and a range of local schools, the home is well placed for commuters, families and those who enjoy green space. The EPC rating is D and the Council Tax band is A.

This spacious three-bedroom semi-detached home in the popular Clock Face area of St Helens requires some finishing touches, offering scope to add your own stamp. The vendor is open to negotiation.

The large private rear garden includes a versatile garden room suitable as a home office, gym, playroom or hobby space. Close to schools, amenities and transport links, with no onward chain.

properties.address: St Lukes Road, St Helens, 4 WA10
properties.summary:
This two-bedroom freehold semi-detached house sits on St Lukes Road in St Helens and is offered with no onward chain. The property has an open-plan living and dining room, an extended fitted kitchen, and a modern shower room. The principal bedroom has large fitted wardrobes.

Outside, there is driveway parking to the front and a low-maintenance rear garden with a flagged patio and artificial lawn. The property is rated EPC C and Council Tax Band B.

properties.address: Cambridge Road, Newtown, St Helens WA10
properties.summary:
This two-bedroom terraced terraced house is offered with no onward chain, making it an attractive proposition for buyers seeking a reliable transaction. The property requires renovation and presents a blank canvas for transformation, whether creating a family home or investment opportunity.

The ground floor features two reception rooms and access to the kitchen and lean-to, while upstairs offers two double bedrooms and a bathroom. Externally, there's convenient on-street parking and a generous rear garden with potential. Located on popular Cambridge Road near Queens Park and local amenities.

This freehold corner building plot on Irwin Road, St Helens, is offered for sale in a popular residential area close to local schools and commuter links. The plot previously had planning history for a four-bedroom detached house with integral garage, and footings and slab are already completed on the site.

The listing has been back on the market after a period off, and has been listed since February 2025. Buyers should review the planning application referenced in the listing and make their own enquiries with the local council regarding any further consents.
